messages:
maya: Quick ask — marketing needs heatmap + cold-start vs steady-state benchmark reruns for our quantized variants (13B q4_0 and 70B q8_0) to validate launch numbers. Need methodology write-up + raw CSVs and a heatmap image by EOD Tue. Can eng/runtime take this on?

liam: Can do but need clarifications: which sequence lengths, concurrency profiles, and exact payload set? Also: do you want cold-start defined as first request after process start or after idle (30s)?

maya: Use marketing payload set `mkting-payloads-2026-03-10` (shared in drive). Sequence buckets: 32, 128, 512. Concurrency sweep: 1, 4, 8, 16. Cold-start = first request after process start (so include container restart between cold-start runs). Please capture p50/p95/p99, first-token latency, and steady-state tokens/sec. Heatmap: latency (ms) on y, concurrency on x, separate panels per seq length.

harsh: OK. We'll run on the usual runtime harness (A100 baseline) and add an H100 sample if capacity allows. A couple notes: 1) quantized model binaries may need a warm compile pass on first run — we'll record that separately. 2) KV-cache behavior will differ for streaming vs non-streaming; confirm whether to include streaming runs.

maya: Include streaming vs non-streaming for the 13B only (demo will show stream improvement). For the 70B just do non-streaming. Also include a short methodology section outlining: seed, randomization of request order, duration per point (60s steady-state after 30s warmup), and measurement tooling.

liam: Got it. Quick proposed config snippet we'll use for reproducibility:

```
model: redwood-13b-q4_0
seq_lengths: [32,128,512]
concurrency: [1,4,8,16]
warmup_seconds: 30
steady_seconds: 60
sampling: deterministic
payload_set: mkting-payloads-2026-03-10
metrics: [p50,p95,p99,first_token_ms,tokens_per_sec]
artifact_bucket: s3://redwood-bench-marketing/2059876543/
```

liam: Also planning to collect raw per-request CSVs and a summary JSON. Any required fields for the marketing team?

elaine: For marketing the CSV should include: request_id, seq_length, concurrency_level, model_variant, node_type, first_token_ms, last_token_ms, tokens_generated, cpu_gpu_util. And pls upload the heatmap PNG + a short README with commands to reproduce the runs.

harsh: Scheduling: we'll enqueue runs for Tue 09:00 UTC. ETA for artifacts: Wed 15:00 UTC (includes H100 sample if it completes). We'll attach a short methodology.md and raw CSVs to the artifact bucket. Note: first-run compile times will be marked as outliers and excluded from steady-state numbers; we'll explicitly show the raw values in the CSV.

maya: Amazing, thanks. Can you add a short lines for the PR/launch claim text so we don't mis-state numbers? Something like: "X% median latency improvement in streaming 13B quantized over non-streaming" — we'll craft copy after we see numbers but pls flag any comparisons that are not apples-to-apples. :thumbsup:

harsh: Will do — we'll include a small comparisons table and call out differences in hardware, batch, and model config.

engbot: Job scheduled: bench-job-2059876543-01 queued by liam, expected start Tue 09:00 UTC.

liam: One more: I'll drop a small script to the drive to convert raw CSV -> marketing-ready table. Will ping here when uploaded.

maya: Perfect — ping me when artifacts land. Thanks all! :rocket:
